main_text.p: Act.2.18. & saltem, Luc.19.42. ἀλλὰ tamen propter, Luc.18.5. ἀλλὰ tamen, at certè, 1.Cor.9.2. καίτοι etsi, Johan.4.2. μένγε imò verò. εἰ δὲ μὴ alioquin, Matth.9.17. sin minus, Luc.13.9. ὅσγε qui quidem, Rom.8.32. μήπως nedum, 1.Cor.6.3.
Γείτων ὁ ἡ vicinus a, Luc.15.6,9.

Γέεννα ἡς ἡ gehenna, orcus. vox Hebraea composita, & vertitur vallis Hinnomi: ubi olim Israelita superstitionibus vicinarum gentium addicti filios suos idolo Molecho adolebant, inaudita quadam immanitate. Sic ergo locus damnatorum dictus fuit per metaphoram, Matth.23.33.
Γελάω ῶ rideo. Fut. γελάσω. Luc.6.21. P. γεγελακα. aor.1. ἐγέλασα. P.pass. γεγέλασμαι. a.1. ἐγελάσθην.
Γέλως ωτος ὁ risus. poëtice γέλως ω ὁ, Jac.4.9.
Γέμω plenus sum, Matth.23.25,27. in part. γέμων γέμουσα γέμον. prat.med. γέμομαι.
Γεμίζω impleo. F. ίσω. P. γεγέμισμαι. a.1. ἐγέμισα. praes.pass. γεμίζομαι, impleor. P.pass. γεγέμισμαι. a.1.pass. ἐγεμίσθην, Luc.14.23.
Γενεὰ ᾶς ἡ generatio, Matth.1. verf.17. ætas, Luc.1.50. εἰς γενεὰς γενεῶν in omnes ætates. gens, Heb.3.v.10. γενεὰ σκολιὰ natio prava, Actor.2.40.
Γενεαλογία ας ἡ genealogia, generis recensio, 1.Timoth.1.4. ἀ γενεαλόγος ὁ genealogiæ scriptor.

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right edge are cut off and only partly legible (fragments of Greek and Latin cross-references such as "Matth.1.18."); they are not transcribed in full. Greek words are transcribed from the scan and may contain errors; several accent marks are doubtful.
